item.title: Rallying Cry – October 17, 2026
item.description: Pope Leo is back home after a successful cancer operation, while dozens of critically endangered orangutans were rescued from wildfires in Indonesia, and a fun-filled squash festival in Brussels drew thousands of visitors excited to celebrate the season.
